warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง; windows give sill + opening against the printed head height (น1 0.45 + 1.60 = 2.05, น2/น3 0.85 + 1.10 = 1.95 against a printed 2.05, น4 1.65 + 0.60 = 2.25). The น2/น3 0.10 shortfall is kept as printed.
ป4's หมายเหตุ cell is empty on the sheet (the others print '-'), so its note is null.
